summary: Implemented prepared SPARQL Update (prepareUpdate) in the RDFLib repo, without running tests or committing. Changes: (1) rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py: added Update container class (prologue, algebra) beside Query. (2) rdflib/plugins/sparql/algebra.py: translateUpdate now always returns an Update; the empty-request early return uses translatePrologue([], base, initNs) and an empty algebra list; the non-empty path returns the translated prologue and operations. Imported Update. (3) rdflib/plugins/sparql/update.py: evalUpdate iterates update.algebra; docstring updated. (4) rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py: added prepareUpdate(updateString, initNs={}, base=None) beside prepareQuery, recording _original_args; SPARQLUpdateProcessor unchanged. (5) rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py: exports prepareUpdate. (6) test/test_sparql_prepared_update.py (new): covers prepare-then-Graph.update, reuse across graphs and repeated application, initNs prefixes, direct evalUpdate, container shape including empty request, empty update string via Graph.update/processUpdate, and a no-mutation snapshot check. Choices: snapshot uses op name, repr(dict(op)), and prologue reference; prepareUpdate has no return annotation. DAWG tests needed no change. All verification was by reading only; no tests were run.
